newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Compuserve cut near-term.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Compuserve cut near-term.

text.p: -EVEREN Securities Inc said Monday it cut its near-term rating on CompuServe Corp to underperform from market perform. It is maintaining its long-term rating of market perform.

-Earnings per share estimates were also cut to greater-than-expected subscriber defections, EVEREN said. It cut its estimate for the fourth fiscal quarter ending in April to a loss of $0.12 from a loss of $0.07, which puts the fiscal 1997 estimate at a loss of $0.78, down from a loss of $0.73. Estimates for fiscal 1998 were cut to a profit of $0.01 from $0.23, and for fiscal 1999 to a profit of $0.37 from $0.50, EVEREN said.
